svg.title: 逐步重写一个目标

text.font-family: 'Isabelle DejaVu Sans Mono', 'DejaVu Sans Mono', Consolas, Menlo, 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', monospace

svg.text: allows (grant u Read es) u Read

text.font-family: 'Isabelle DejaVu Sans Mono', 'DejaVu Sans Mono', Consolas, Menlo, 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', monospace

svg.text: (1) grant u p es = (u, p) # es

text.font-family: 'Isabelle DejaVu Sans Mono', 'DejaVu Sans Mono', Consolas, Menlo, 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', monospace
'Isabelle DejaVu Sans Mono', 'DejaVu Sans Mono', Consolas, Menlo, 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', monospace

svg.text: (2) allows (e # es) u p = (e = (u, p) ∨ allows es u p)

text.font-family: 'Isabelle DejaVu Sans Mono', 'DejaVu Sans Mono', Consolas, Menlo, 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', monospace

svg.text: (u, Read) = (u, Read) ∨ allows es u Read
